Nina: Heads-up 12:30pm courier dropping a 'sushi sample box' + a small art rug for a visiting partner. Can we stage them and print a temp badge? :sushi: :rug::package:
Marcus: Receiving shelf A is empty right now. Please avoid the high table (coffee spill risk).
FrontDeskBot: Delivery logged: 1x sushi sample box (label: 'Yamamoto') + 1x small rug (recipient: Marcus). Location: Receiving Shelf A. Temp badge color: navy. Notes: sushi must be refrigerated in 30 mins; rug marked "fragile - dry clean".
Ivy: I'll meet at concierge and escort. Can someone save the ottoman by the cafe 12:25-12:50? Quick react poll: :thumbsup: to reserve ottoman, :thumbsdown: if you need it.
Marcus: :thumbsup: I'll move my laptop bag. Also Marcus: I'll place a "do not sit - staging" sticky on the ottoman.
Nina: FrontDeskBot 12:20 please flag sushi for fridge and set temp badge to navy. Also Facilities help at 12:22 if delivery looks heavy.
FrontDeskBot: Done 12:20 fridge note added; temp badge color navy set; Facilities notified for 12:22. Delivery log updated.
_meta: short slack thread coordinating courier drop with perishable sample, rug staging, temp badge, and seating reservation
